contact.title: Talk to a person, not a bot.
contact.lead: Questions about setting up, payments, shipping or a partnership. Pick the channel that suits you.
contact.whatsappBody: Fastest for store and order questions. Send screenshots, voice notes, anything.
contact.emailBody: For detailed requests, documents and partnerships.
contact.phoneBody: Prefer to talk it through? Give us a call.
contact.formBody: Tell us a bit about you and we'll route it to the right person.
contact.sentBody: We'll get back to you by email. For anything urgent, message us on WhatsApp.
